35561.title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
35561.zh_title: 关税向消费者价格传导的剖析
35561.authors: Mary Amiti, Sebastian Heise, David Weinstein
35561.zh_abstract_excerpt: 关税不仅会提高其所征税的进口商品的价格，还会提高国内生产的商品的价格——这一效应是标准传导估计在很大程度上忽略的。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现大约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估计是相对于受冲击较小的商品进行衡量的，并保持总体条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某种商品外国品种的消费者价格。
35561.abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
35561.zh_abstract: 关税不仅会提高其所征税的进口商品的价格，还会提高国内生产的商品的价格——这一效应是标准传导估计在很大程度上忽略的。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现大约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估计是相对于受冲击较小的商品进行衡量的，并保持总体条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某种商品外国品种的消费者价格。其余36%来自间接效应——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品的成本，而国内生产商因面临来自高价进口商品的竞争减少而提高了加成率。直接效应传导迅速，因为关税几乎立即推高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九到十二个月才能通过供应链发挥作用。因此，关税对消费者的影响比仅直接效应所显示的要更大且更持久。

35560.title: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
35560.zh_title: H-1B移民对美国经济的长期影响
35560.authors: Ran Abramitzky, Leah Platt Boustan, Ahmet Gulek, Jens Hainmueller
35560.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了H-1B移民对雇佣H-1B工人的美国行业及其贸易伙伴的影响。利用一种新颖的跨行业设计以及1999-2003年H-1B签证上限的扩大进行识别，我们发现H-1B暴露提高了本土居民和原有移民的收入，且收益集中在非STEM职业。收入收益通过供应链向前传导至下游行业，但不会向后传导至上游行业，这与生产率冲击而非劳动力供给冲击相一致。我们没有发现对专利活动的直接影响，这表明生产率收益源于更好的任务执行，而非可专利的发明。
35560.abstract: We study the effects of H-1B immigration on U.S. industries that employ H-1B workers and their trading partners. Using a novel cross-industry design and the 1999–2003 expansion of the H-1B visa cap for identification, we find that H-1B exposure raised incomes for natives and pre-existing immigrants, with gains concentrated in non-STEM occupations. Income gains propagate forward through supply chains to downstream industries but not backward to upstream industries, consistent with a productivity shock rather than a labor supply shock. We find no direct effect on patenting, suggesting that productivity gains arise from better task execution rather than patentable invention.

35559.title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
35559.zh_title: 可替代但仍在就业：自动化与工作的意义
35559.zh_abstract_excerpt: 自动化能否在不取代工人的情况下损害工人？我们研究了工人既重视生产有用产出又重视产出取决于自身贡献这一情况的工作。一个可信的机器替代方案会削弱第二种意义来源，即使企业保留该工人。我们的模型表明，当工资完全调整时，这种损失会提高薪酬；当工资仅部分调整时，工人自身承担部分损失。它还可能使自动化更有可能发生。外部开发者可能通过公开演示机器再授权许可而获利，因为演示降低了人类替代方案的价值。
35559.abstract: Can automation harm workers without replacing them? We study jobs in which workers value both producing useful output and knowing that the output depends on their own contribution. A credible machine alternative can weaken that second source of meaning even when the firm retains the worker. Our model shows that this loss raises compensation when wages adjust fully; when they adjust only partly, workers bear some of the loss themselves. It can also make automation more likely. An external developer may profit by publicly demonstrating a machine before licensing it, because the demonstration lowers the value of the human alternative. This "meaning externality" can create demand for the machine and make profitable development socially harmful. Better technical quality and greater public salience have different effects: quality improves output, while salience alone weakens human work. Automation can, therefore, reduce the value of work before it eliminates jobs.

35558.title: Unpacking Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in a Large-Scale Dropout-Prevention Experiment
35558.zh_title: 大规模辍学预防实验中的处理效应异质性解析
35558.authors: Thomas Dee, Chloe R. Gibbs, Rebecca Margolit-Chan, Lillian Morrell, James X. Sullivan
35558.zh_abstract_excerpt: 及时完成高中学业是成功过渡到高等教育和劳动力市场的关键一步。这项随机对照试验在两个城市弱势学区开展，以异常大的规模（n=2,528）测试了一个成熟且全面的学生支持项目的有效性。虽然对毕业率的总体影响较小且统计上不显著，但探索性分析揭示了因地点和时间而异的显著差异，反映了处理时机和项目实施中的异质性。这些发现凸显了扩大干预规模的挑战，并引发了对从小规模、单地点评估中推广结果的担忧。
35558.abstract: Timely high school completion is a critical step in successful transitions to post-secondary schooling and the labor market. This randomized controlled trial, deployed in two urban, disadvantaged school districts, tests the effectiveness of a mature and comprehensive student-support program on an unusually large scale (n=2,528). While overall effects on graduation rates are small and statistically insignificant, exploratory analyses reveal notable variation by site and over time, mirroring heterogeneity in treatment timing and program implementation. These findings highlight the challenges of scaling interventions and raise concerns about generalizing results from small-scale, single-site evaluations.

35557.title: Demand for Safety in the Crypto Ecosystem
35557.zh_title: 加密生态系统中的安全需求
35557.authors: Murillo Campello, Angela Gallo, Lira Mota, Tammaro Terracciano
35557.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了加密生态系统中对安全性和流动性的需求。我们在一个代表性投资者在借贷池中的稳定币存款和传统安全资产（如货币市场基金份额）之间分配流动性的框架下进行研究。我们的模型得出三个主要预测：（i）当投资者重视稳定币的安全性和流动性服务时，稳定币存款溢价与国债溢价共同变动；（ii）国债供给增加会降低稳定币存款溢价；（iii）稳定币存款感知安全性和流动性下降（例如由于脱钩或黑客攻击）会降低其溢价。
35557.abstract: We study the demand for safety and liquidity in the crypto ecosystem. We do so under a framework in which a representative investor allocates liquidity across stablecoin deposits in lending pools and traditional safe assets (e.g., MMF shares). Our model delivers three main predictions: (i) the stablecoin deposit premium co-moves with the Treasury premium when investors value the safety and liquidity services of stablecoins; (ii) increases in Treasury supply reduce the stablecoin deposit premium; and (iii) drops in the perceived safety and liquidity of stablecoin deposits (e.g., due to de-pegs or hacker attacks) reduce their premium. Using granular data from hundreds of DeFi pools spanning multiple protocols, tokens, and blockchains, we find evidence supporting these predictions. Investors treat stablecoin deposits as money-like instruments that are borderless and permissionless, yet as fragile as other forms of privately produced safe assets.

35556.title: Meritocracy and the Networks It Forged: China’s Imperial Examination
35556.zh_title: 贤能政治及其缔造的网络：中国的科举制度
35556.zh_abstract_excerpt: 声称奖励贤能的制度往往也充当推动重要社会网络形成的引擎。我们考察了科举制度——历史上寿命最长的贤能政治体系之一——中的这一双重角色。我们利用清朝（1644–1905年）112场全国性考试中24,269名考生的考试成绩数据，追踪其中哪些人晋升为高级官员。优异的考试成绩增加了获得高官职位的可能性，但晋升也取决于个人与有权势考官的联系。由于考试成绩与有权势考官的联系具有强烈的互补性，个人的成功看似基于贤能，即便社会网络也发挥了作用。
35556.abstract: Institutions that claim to reward merit often also serve as engines that drive the formation of important social networks. We examine this dual role in China’s Imperial Examination, one of history’s longest-lived meritocratic systems. We draw on exam performance data for 24,269 individuals across 112 national examinations in the Qing dynasty (1644–1905) and trace who among them rose to become top officials. Strong exam performance increased the likelihood of attaining high office, but advancement also depended on individuals’ ties to powerful examiners. Because performance and ties to powerful examiners were strongly complementary, individuals’ success appeared to rest on merit even as social networks played a role. Following the major political transformations of the 1840s, the importance of examiner ties persisted, although the influential examiners themselves changed. These findings help explain why such systems retain legitimacy even when networks matter greatly.

35555.title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
35555.zh_title: 美国及其债权人：评估对美国资产的外国需求
35555.authors: Anusha Chari, Gian Maria Milesi Ferretti
35555.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文分析了外国对美国资产的需求，特别强调了美国国债。它记录了美国双边外部头寸在地理区域和资产类别上的构成变化，提供了更接近基于国籍概念的债权人头寸估计。虽然美国股票价格上涨解释了净外部头寸恶化的大部分，但外国购买美国国债一直是美国经常账户融资的最大来源。在过去十年中，外国官方投资者持有的这些证券份额急剧下降，而外国私人投资者（尤其是通过金融中心）持有的份额则有所上升。
35555.abstract: This paper analyzes foreign demand for U.S. assets, with particular emphasis on U.S. Treasury securities. It documents compositional shifts in U.S. bilateral external positions across geographic regions and asset classes, providing estimates of creditor positions closer to a nationality-based concept. While rising U.S. equity prices explain a sizable share of the deterioration in the net external position, foreign purchases of U.S. Treasury securities have been the largest source of U.S. current account financing. The share of these securities held by foreign official investors has declined sharply during the past decade, while the share held by foreign private investors (especially through financial centers) has risen. The decline in foreign official holdings is well explained by lower reserve accumulation, increased Federal Reserve holdings, and dollar appreciation against other reserve currencies. The evidence is consistent with central banks rebalancing their portfolios to avoid large swings in currency shares. Geoeconomic fragmentation is negatively correlated with official demand for U.S. Treasuries, while foreign private demand remains sensitive to safe-haven dynamics. Overall, the paper assesses how these structural shifts affect portfolio preferences for U.S. assets and their potential implications for the U.S. external position amid heightened geopolitical and fiscal uncertainty.

35554.title: A Theory of Firm Wage Dynamics
35554.authors: Marc de la Barrera, Masao Fukui
35554.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们发展了一个企业工资动态理论，该理论将经典的工资设定模型（Burdett and Mortensen, 1998）与企业动态相结合。在存在搜索摩擦的情况下，企业在同等对待约束下提供动态工资合同。我们提供了均衡工资合同和企业增长的解析特征，它们仅作为边际剩余分布的函数。与近期经验证据一致，该模型意味着：（i）企业工资与企业增长密切相关，但与企业规模无关；（ii）企业工资在企业生命周期内下降；
35554.abstract: We develop a theory of firm wage dynamics that integrates the canonical wage-posting model à la Burdett and Mortensen (1998) with firm dynamics. Firms offer dynamic wage contracts under an equal-treatment constraint in the presence of search frictions. We provide an analytical characterization of equilibrium wage contracts and firm growth as functions only of the distribution of marginal surplus. Consistent with recent empirical evidence, the model implies that (i) firm wages are strongly linked to firm growth but not to firm size; (ii) firm wages decline over the firm life cycle; and (iii) the pass-through of permanent productivity shocks to wages is higher in the short run than in the long run. Firms at the top of the job ladder face excessive labor market competition, so the optimal policy subsidizes their hiring. At the macro level, the optimal policy elevates business dynamism in the steady state, and even more so along the transition.
35554.zh_abstract: 我们发展了一个企业工资动态理论，该理论将经典的工资设定模型（Burdett and Mortensen, 1998）与企业动态相结合。在存在搜索摩擦的情况下，企业在同等对待约束下提供动态工资合同。我们提供了均衡工资合同和企业增长的解析特征，它们仅作为边际剩余分布的函数。与近期经验证据一致，该模型意味着：（i）企业工资与企业增长密切相关，但与企业规模无关；（ii）企业工资在企业生命周期内下降；（iii）永久性生产率冲击对工资的传导在短期内高于长期。处于工作阶梯顶端的企业面临过度的劳动力市场竞争，因此最优政策补贴其招聘。在宏观层面，最优政策在稳态下提升了商业活力，在转型过程中更是如此。

35553.title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
35553.zh_title: 分担负担：葡萄牙药剂师部门改革对药剂师劳动力市场的影响
35553.authors: David Card, Ana Rute Cardoso, Pedro Luis Silva
35553.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在2010年金融危机最严重时期，葡萄牙政府对其处方药报销体系实施了一系列改革。在接下来的三年里，零售药房每位药剂师创造的附加值下降了三分之一，这反映了仿制药替代的增加和处方药允许加价的降低。这一巨大冲击导致在职药剂师的工资削减，并为新员工引入了两级薪酬体系，而就业增长几乎没有减少。我们使用来自Quadros de Pessoal数据库的详细纵向记录，并结合集体谈判协议和企业财务记录的信息，来研究这些改革的影响。
35553.abstract: In the depths of the 2010 financial crisis the Portuguese government enacted a series of reforms in its prescription drug reimbursement system. Over the next three years value added per pharmacist in retail pharmacies fell by a third, reflecting a rise in generic substitution and reductions in the markups allowed for prescription drugs. This massive shock led to pay cuts for incumbent pharmacists and the introduction of a two-tier pay system for new hires, with little or no reduction in the growth of employment. We use detailed longitudinal records from the Quadros de Pessoal data base, merged with information on collective bargaining settlements and firm financial records, to study the impacts of the reforms. We estimate that between 2009 and 2022 average wages of pharmacists fell by a third; most of this reduction was due to lower wages for newly entering cohorts. The implied responsiveness of wages to productivity is substantially above most estimates in the rent-sharing literature, arguably reflecting the strong attachment of workers to the sector and the steady inflow of newly graduating pharmacists. Stepping back, we then consider how wages of pharmacists have diverged relative to wages of other health care professionals in Portugal, and the decisions of recent college applicants to enter the profession.

35552.title: The Equilibrium Impact of Credit Frictions: Evidence from Default Risk Using Firm-Level Data
35552.zh_title: 信贷摩擦的均衡影响：基于企业层面数据的违约风险证据
35552.authors: Timothy J. Besley, Peter John Lambert, Isabelle A. Michalski-Roland, John Van Reenen
35552.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文考察了由企业层面违约风险产生的信贷摩擦对总体经济表现的影响。我们构建了一个具有异质性企业和部门特定生产函数的微观到宏观模型，表明感知违约风险是信贷摩擦的充分统计量。使用英国行政数据（2004–2019年）与S&P风险度量相匹配，反事实估计显示，放松摩擦可使产出提高25%，工资提高23%。忽略均衡工资调整会高估产出收益，而忽略固定资本错配则会低估它们。大部分收益反映了总资本积累。
35552.abstract: This paper examines the impact of credit frictions arising from firm-level default risk on aggregate economic performance. We build a micro-to-macro model with heterogeneous firms and sector-specific production functions, showing that perceived default risk is a sufficient statistic for credit frictions. Using UK administrative data (2004–2019) matched to S&P risk measures, counterfactual estimates reveal that relaxing frictions raises output by 25% and wages by 23%. Ignoring equilibrium wage adjustments overstates output gains, while fixed-capital misallocation approaches understate them. Most gains reflect aggregate capital accumulation. Credit frictions remain above pre-crisis levels, reshape firm size dynamics, increase misallocation across firms, and dampen productivity growth over time.

35551.title: Chinese Sputnik Moments?
35551.zh_title: 中国的斯普特尼克时刻？
35551.authors: Josh Lerner, Namrata Narain, Dimitris Papanikolaou, Amit Seru, Zunda Winston Xu
35551.zh_abstract_excerpt: 中国近几十年的技术进步一直受到钦佩、警惕，有时甚至是怀疑。为了更好地理解中国的创新生态系统，我们编制了一个包含近1400万件中国国内专利出版物的数据集。我们重点关注美国国防部确定的关键技术子集。数据中出现了几个令人惊讶的模式：中国专利活动与其他创新进展指标密切相关；专利并非集中在华为等企业巨头手中；大学在创新中发挥了关键作用，其作用远大于国有企业或政府所属机构；并且，不到十分之一的中国关键技术专利涉及具有美国经验或培训背景的发明人。
35551.abstract: China’s technological progress in recent decades has been viewed with admiration, alarm, and (in some cases) doubt. To better understand the Chinese innovation ecosystem, we compile a dataset of almost 14 million domestic Chinese patent publications. We focus on the subset of critical technologies identified by the U.S. Department of Defense. Several surprising patterns emerge from the data: Chinese patenting is strongly associated with other measures of innovative progress; patents are not concentrated in corporate giants such as Huawei; universities have played a key role in innovation, much greater than state-owned enterprises or government-owned facilities; and fewer than one in ten Chinese critical technology patents involves an inventor with U.S. experience or training. Finally, using four text-based measures of patent quality, we show that the rise of Chinese patenting in critical technologies has not been associated with a decline in quality relative to the U.S. awards.

35550.title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
35550.authors: Ricardo Alonso, Monica Martinez-Bravo, Gerard Padró I Miquel, Carlos Sanz, Silvia Vannutelli
35550.zh_abstract_excerpt: 责任明确性是政治问责制的基本要素。我们构建了一个在存在模糊归因情况下进行贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并使用一项原创调查检验其预测。我们发现，受访者的党派立场、对公共医疗质量的评估以及关于哪一层级政府负责医疗的信念之间的相关性符合预测：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党所治理的层级，而评估不佳的选民则归咎于其不喜欢的政党所治理的层级。这种党派性的功劳与责备模式，常被解释为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但也可以在归因模糊下通过理性贝叶斯更新而产生。
35550.abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents’ partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.

35549.title: Selecting Innovation Funding Mechanisms: A Framework for Policymakers
35549.zh_title: 选择创新资助机制：政策制定者框架
35549.authors: Matthew S. Clancy, Matthew Esche, Siddhartha Haria, Claire T. McMahon, Christopher M. Snyder, Caleb Watney
35549.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国联邦政府每年通过拨款、合同、奖项、预先市场承诺和税收抵免等机制，在研发上花费约1500亿美元。这些资助机制在风险分配、决策权和激励力度上差异显著，但政策制定者在选择时缺乏系统性指导。我们构建了一个框架，要求政策制定者就缔约环境回答三个初始问题：他们能否明确需要完成的工作？他们能否明确什么构成成功的解决方案？他们能否识别出最有能力的执行者进行缔约？答案能大幅缩小可行机制的范围，从而基于创新经济学文献中的进一步考量，更易选择出有效机制。
35549.abstract: The U.S. federal government spends roughly $150 billion a year on research and development through mechanisms ranging from grants and contracts to prizes, advance market commitments, and tax credits. These funding mechanisms differ markedly in risk allocation, decision authority, and incentive power, yet policymakers have little systematic guidance for choosing among them. We develop a framework that asks the policymaker three initial questions about the contracting environment: Can they articulate the work to be done? Can they specify what would constitute a successful solution? Can they identify the most capable performers to contract with? The answers considerably narrow the set of viable mechanisms, enabling a more tractable choice of the efficient mechanism based on further considerations from the innovation-economics literature.
35549.zh_abstract: 美国联邦政府每年通过拨款、合同、奖项、预先市场承诺和税收抵免等机制，在研发上花费约1500亿美元。这些资助机制在风险分配、决策权和激励力度上差异显著，但政策制定者在选择时缺乏系统性指导。我们构建了一个框架，要求政策制定者就缔约环境回答三个初始问题：他们能否明确需要完成的工作？他们能否明确什么构成成功的解决方案？他们能否识别出最有能力的执行者进行缔约？答案能大幅缩小可行机制的范围，从而基于创新经济学文献中的进一步考量，更易选择出有效机制。

35548.title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
35548.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了当二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行准备金和公共流动性的作用。中央银行准备金帮助中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任下，中介机构持有的准备金不足，忽视了总流动性如何降低冻结风险。我们提出了一个“市场最后支持原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则将基于状态依赖的最后买家干预以恢复交易，与适度的流动性要求相结合以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。
35548.abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a "market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.

35547.title: Designing Around Selection: Identification and Inference Under Multi-Dimensional Unobserved Heterogeneity
35547.zh_title: 围绕选择进行设计：多维不可观测异质性下的识别与推断
35547.authors: Brent R. Hickman, John A. List, Ian Muir, Gregory K. Sun
35547.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了一类广泛的委托-代理模型中的识别与最优政策设计。我们证明，文献中最常见的实证框架等价于一个非结构化的潜在结果模型，并附加了三个特定假设：需求定律（LoD），即处理效应单调性；外推模型结构（EMS），它排除了代理人对价格变化的非平滑响应；以及秩不变性（RI），它将不可观测异质性（UH）限制为1维。这一分解隔离了每个假设的识别内容，并阐明了其经济作用。LoD和MS可以使用外生价格变动进行实证检验；
35547.abstract: We study identification and optimal policy design in a broad class of principal-agent models. We show that the most common empirical framework within the literature is equivalent to an unstructured potential-outcomes model augmented with three specific assumptions: the Law of Demand (LoD), or treatment-effect monotonicity; extrapolative model structure (EMS), which rules out lumpy agent responses to price changes; and rank invariance (RI), which restricts unobserved heterogeneity (UH) to be one-dimensional. This decomposition isolates the identifying content of each assumption and clarifies its economic role. The LoD and MS are empirically testable using exogenous price variation; RI, on the other hand, is a strong assumption ruling out many economically plausible behaviors, and also not empirically testable. We derive sharp bounds on counterfactual outcomes when RI is relaxed. The conventional 1-dimensional model delivers an upper bound on planner objectives, while the lower bound, which allows for arbitrary multi-dimensional UH, has an adversarial interpretation for policy design. We estimate empirical bounds and apply them to nonlinear pricing of rideshare services. The resulting robust pricing policy fully insures against worst-case latent selection while preserving most of the profit and consumer-surplus gains predicted by the conventional model. Our framework provides a tractable approach to robust policy design in adverse-selection settings including Mirrleesian taxation, regulation, labor supply, and procurement.

35546.title: Time Travel on Professional Profiles
35546.zh_title: 职业档案中的时间旅行
35546.authors: Nicholas Bloom, Gideon Moore, Lisa K. Simon, Caelan Wilkie-Rogers
35546.zh_abstract_excerpt: 经济学家越来越多地使用职业档案数据来重建就业历史并衡量技能供给。我们表明，这些记录并非固定的历史快照，而是工人随时间修改的可变账户。利用2020–2026年Revelio Labs数据的月度版本，我们记录了19.7%的美国成熟LinkedIn用户会追溯性地编辑其已离职工作的职位或描述。这些“时间旅行”编辑与劳动力市场转变密切相关：在这些编辑前后，工人更换雇主的可能性远高于后来编辑的用户。
35546.abstract: Economists increasingly use professional profile data to reconstruct employment histories and measure skill supply. We show that these records are not fixed historical snapshots, but mutable accounts that workers revise over time. Using monthly vintages of Revelio Labs data from 2020–2026, we document that 19.7 percent of established U.S. LinkedIn users retroactively edit the title or description of a job they have already left. These “time-travel” edits are closely tied to labor market transitions: around such edits, workers are much more likely to change employers as compared to later-editing users. This mutability can bias historical measures of skills, but it also reveals workers’ beliefs about which skills are in demand. Retroactive edits show sharp post-2022 increases in AI-related language and recent reductions in work-from-home and DEI language. Finally, LLM-associated writing markers surge after ChatGPT, especially among less-educated groups and MBAs from lower-ranked programs, revealing heterogeneous AI-assisted profile editing.

35545.title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
35545.zh_title: 在关键节点展开时进行检测：来自120年报道的基础、测量与应用
35545.authors: Michael Callen, Gregory Levy, Saipremnath Muthukumaran, Jonathan L. Weigel, Noam Yuchtman
35545.zh_abstract_excerpt: 解释为什么一些国家变得富裕而另一些国家仍然贫穷，需要了解制度如何以及何时发生变化。大量研究认为，制度变革往往发生在关键节点：即多种制度未来成为可能，包括回归现状的时刻。然而，大多数实证研究仅回顾性地考察关键节点，这可能导致遗漏那些制度处于变动之中但最终未发生改变的 pivotal 时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，在关键节点展开时进行检测。
35545.abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how — and when — institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive — 11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019 — while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s — a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
35545.zh_abstract: 解释为什么一些国家变得富裕而另一些国家仍然贫穷，需要了解制度如何以及何时发生变化。大量研究认为，制度变革往往发生在关键节点：即多种制度未来成为可能，包括回归现状的时刻。然而，大多数实证研究仅回顾性地考察关键节点，这可能导致遗漏那些制度处于变动之中但最终未发生改变的 pivotal 时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，在关键节点展开时进行检测。我们的核心洞见是将关键节点理解为关于制度的不确定性时刻，这为文本分类器提供了一个在同期话语中检测的、具有理论动机的对象。在本章中，我们利用报纸文本作为关于当代制度不确定性信念的丰富信息来源，将这一思想应用于历史关键节点的研究。我们通过训练一个基于大型语言模型的分类器，将这一洞见转化为测量策略，并将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案——涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章——同时将主要实证分析聚焦于1900年至2019年的120年报道。这产生了第一个基于文本的、以关键节点概念为基础的长期制度不确定性测量。与既有的地缘政治和经济风险指数相比，我们的测量在多个方面进行了创新：（i）即使在正式制度变革缺失的时期，它也能捕捉到高不确定性，这与关键节点的事前定义一致；（ii）它为重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）提供了更早的信号；（iii）它使用共同的事前测量来评估候选关键节点；（iv）它为研究关键节点如何塑造制度和长期发展开辟了新途径。如今，我们基于《泰晤士报》的指数表明，美国和英国的制度不确定性与1940年代初一样高——这是其他主要风险测量所遗漏的信号。

35544.title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
35544.zh_title: 两个选择问题，一个偏差项：实验报名是伪装的处置选择
35544.zh_abstract_excerpt: 考虑一份审稿报告中包含这样的句子：“处置分配是自愿的，尽管作者在结论中承认这是一个局限性。”编辑会立即拒绝。现在将“处置分配”替换为“进入实验样本”，这句话描述的就是典型的已发表实验。本研究表明，这两种偏差是同一个数学对象。非随机样本进入的偏差是经典选择分解中的收益排序项。有趣的是，它们都承认同构的罗伊微观基础和逆米尔斯特征。一个简单的校准表明，对于典型实验，观察到的偏差可能很大。解决此偏差的一种方法是进行自然田野实验（NFE）。
35544.abstract: Consider a referee report containing the sentence: “Assignment to treatment was voluntary, though the authors acknowledge this as a limitation in the conclusion.” The Editor would summarily reject. Now replace “assignment to treatment” with “entry into the experimental sample,” and the sentence describes the modal published experiment. This study shows that both biases are the same mathematical object. The bias from non-random sample entry is the sorting-on-gains term from the classic selection decomposition. Interestingly, they both admit an isomorphic Roy micro-foundation and inverse-Mills characterization. A simple calibration reveals that for the typical experiment, the observed bias can be large. One solution to this bias is to conduct a natural field experiment (NFE). When an NFE is not possible, three alternative reporting practices are offered.

35543.title: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare
35543.zh_title: 将激励与信息挂钩：诊断结果挂钩合同与医疗中的认知偏差
35543.authors: Maria Dieci, Paul Gertler, Jonathan T. Kolstad, Carlos Paramo
35543.zh_abstract_excerpt: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对其健康状况的认知与实际病情之间的差距；人们常常会针对他们怀疑但并未确认患有的疾病寻求并接受治疗。因此，患者对检测的重视程度取决于其患病先验概率，而当这些认知存在偏差时，检测率可能低于最优水平，从而造成福利损失。我们研究了诊断结果挂钩激励合同，即将治疗激励与诊断结果相关联。针对疟疾，该合同仅对检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断检测（RDTs）和青蒿素联合疗法（ACTs）。
35543.abstract: Unnecessary treatment reflects a gap between what patients believe about their health and their true condition; people often seek and consume care for diseases they suspect, but do not know that actually have. The value a patient places on testing therefore depends on their priors about being sick, and when those beliefs are biased, the resulting testing rate might be sub-optimal and leave welfare on the table. We study diagnosis-contingent incentive contracts, which tie treatment incentives to diagnostic results. For malaria, the contract subsidizes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) and antimalarials (ACTs) only for patients who test positive. In a cluster-randomized experiment across 140 Kenyan pharmacies, both patient subsidies and provider incentives roughly tripled testing and sharply reduced unnecessary ACT purchases among test-negative patients, working through distinct channels: patient subsidies through lower prices, provider incentives through information and advice. A model of patient choice implies these contracts raise social welfare well above their cost. Estimating the model structurally, we find that because patients substantially overestimate their infection risk, loading incentives onto diagnosis-contingent treatment discounts delivers four times the welfare gains of free testing programs.
35543.zh_abstract: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对其健康状况的认知与实际病情之间的差距；人们常常会针对他们怀疑但并未确认患有的疾病寻求并接受治疗。因此，患者对检测的重视程度取决于其患病先验概率，而当这些认知存在偏差时，检测率可能低于最优水平，从而造成福利损失。我们研究了诊断结果挂钩激励合同，即将治疗激励与诊断结果相关联。针对疟疾，该合同仅对检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断检测（RDTs）和青蒿素联合疗法（ACTs）。在一项覆盖肯尼亚140家药店的整群随机实验中，患者补贴和提供者激励均使检测率大约提高了两倍，并大幅减少了检测阴性患者中不必要的ACT购买，其作用机制各不相同：患者补贴通过降低价格发挥作用，提供者激励则通过信息和建议发挥作用。一个患者选择模型表明，这些合同带来的社会福利提升远超其成本。通过对模型进行结构化估计，我们发现，由于患者大幅高估其感染风险，将激励加载到诊断结果挂钩的治疗折扣上，其福利收益是免费检测项目的四倍。

35542.title: Winners and Losers: Competition, Creative Destruction, and Labor Income Risk
35542.zh_title: 赢家与输家：竞争、创造性破坏与劳动收入风险
35542.authors: Brice C. Green, Leonid Kogan, Dimitris Papanikolaou, Lawrence D.W. Schmidt
35542.zh_abstract_excerpt: 利用美国行政数据，我们发现产品市场中由技术驱动的创造性破坏会传导至工人收入。对现有工人收入的传导既不对称又集中：竞争对手创新带来的利润下降导致收入下降和就业破坏可能性变化的比例，大于企业自身创新带来的利润增长所对应的比例，而高收入工人面临的暴露程度显著高于普通工人。我们构建了一个具有买方垄断劳动力市场和工人异质性的内生增长模型，该模型能够复现这种不对称性以及收入风险的分布。
35542.abstract: Using U.S. administrative data, we find that technology-driven creative destruction in the product market passes through to worker earnings. The passthrough to incumbent worker earnings is both asymmetric and concentrated: profit drops from rival innovations lead to proportionally greater earnings declines and changes in the likelihood of job destruction than profit gains from their own firm’s innovations, while top workers are significantly more exposed than the average worker. We develop an endogenous-growth model with monopsonistic labor markets and worker heterogeneity that replicates this asymmetry and the distribution of earnings risk. In the model, creative destruction exposes high-income workers to concentrated downside risk while increasing upward mobility for lower-income workers, shaping the welfare consequences of innovation policy.
35542.zh_abstract: 利用美国行政数据，我们发现产品市场中由技术驱动的创造性破坏会传导至工人收入。对现有工人收入的传导既不对称又集中：竞争对手创新带来的利润下降导致收入下降和就业破坏可能性变化的比例，大于企业自身创新带来的利润增长所对应的比例，而高收入工人面临的暴露程度显著高于普通工人。我们构建了一个具有买方垄断劳动力市场和工人异质性的内生增长模型，该模型能够复现这种不对称性以及收入风险的分布。在该模型中，创造性破坏使高收入工人面临集中的下行风险，同时增加了低收入工人的向上流动性，从而塑造了创新政策的福利后果。

35541.title: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
35541.zh_title: 金融相互依存与货币国际化
35541.zh_abstract_excerpt: 金融开放是否必然导致货币国际化？为研究金融相互依存下在位大国与新兴大国之间的竞争，我们构建了一个具有微观基础网络效应的资产需求模型。与货币专业化中介机构的搜索摩擦在资产市场层面和货币区域层面产生了不同的流动性概念，这些概念共同塑造了货币竞争的轨迹。在中美背景下，处于金融发展早期阶段的中国从将其资产与美元区合并中获益，这强化了现状。随着中国金融市场的深化，人民币发行使中国能够内部化网络效应并削弱美元的支配地位，从而引发向碎片化的离散转变。
35541.abstract: Does financial opening necessarily lead to currency internationalization? To study the competition between incumbent and rising powers under financial interdependence, we develop a model of asset demand with microfounded network effects. Search frictions with currency-specialized intermediaries generate distinct notions of liquidity at asset-market and currency-area levels, which jointly shape the trajectory of currency competition. In the U.S.-China context, China at early stages of financial development benefits from pooling its assets with the dollar area, which reinforces the status quo. As China's financial markets deepen, RMB issuance allows China to internalize network effects and erode the dollar's dominance, triggering a discrete shift toward fragmentation. This transition is further shaped by sanctions, financial repression, and third-country responses, highlighting how financial interdependence transforms cooperation into rivalry in the evolution of the international financial order.

35540.title: Predictive Risk Scores in the Public Sector: Experimental Evidence from Child-Protection Investigations
35540.zh_title: 公共部门的预测性风险评分：来自儿童保护调查的实验证据
35540.authors: E. Jason Baron, Arkadev Ghosh, Richard Lombardo
35540.zh_abstract_excerpt: 许多公共部门决策需要在不确定性下分配稀缺的注意力。我们考察算法风险评估是否能改善儿童保护决策，即监督者决定哪些案件需要更仔细的审查。在宾夕法尼亚州北安普顿县为期14个月、涉及4,752例儿童转介的随机评估中，监督者在标准案件记录之外还获得了算法风险评分。获取该评分增加了对预测风险最高儿童的寄养安置和服务，而对低风险案件几乎没有变化，并减少了后续的虐待转介。
35540.abstract: Many public-sector decisions require allocating scarce attention under uncertainty. We examine whether algorithmic risk assessments improve child-protection decisions, where supervisors decide which cases need closer scrutiny. In a randomized evaluation of 4,752 child referrals over 14 months in Northampton County, supervisors received an algorithmic risk score alongside standard case records. Access to the score increased foster-care placements and services for children at highest predicted risk, with little change for lower-risk cases, and it reduced subsequent maltreatment referrals. We find no evidence that the score widened racial disparities in decisions or outcomes, suggesting algorithms can improve targeting while preserving human discretion.

35539.title: The China Backlash: Quantifying the Narrative Discourse on China
35539.zh_title: 中国反弹：量化关于中国的叙事话语
35539.zh_abstract_excerpt: 使用文本即数据方法，我们量化了美国关于中国的话语，将其置于历史视角中，并比较了不同公共叙事来源的演变。我们的分析基于从公共记录（总统和国会记录、报纸文章、社交媒体、智库报告）中提取的大型语料库。我们开发了两种叙事话语度量：中国被报道频率的指标，以及中国被呈现为积极或消极程度的代理指标。我们记录了自2000年代初以来总统来源中对中国的净情绪持续下降，这早于唐纳德·特朗普的第一个任期。
35539.abstract: Using text-as-data methods, we quantify the U.S. discourse on China, place it in historical perspective, and compare its evolution across different sources of public narrative. Our analysis is based on a large corpus of materials drawn from public records (presidential and congressional records, newspaper articles, social media, think tank reports). We develop two measures of narrative discourse: an indicator of the frequency with which China is covered and a proxy for how positively or negatively China is presented. We document a sustained decline in net sentiment towards China in presidential sources since the early 2000s, predating Donald Trump’s first term in office. In contrast to presidential documents, congressional, news media, social media, and think tank sources exhibit persistent negative sentiment towards China even in decades prior to the 2000s. Instead of a deterioration in sentiment across the board, what we find is a convergence in presidential sentiment to other sources of narrative discourse. We find no evidence that presidential leadership has played a significant role in setting the narrative tone for the nation as a whole. Historical and shorter-term evidence both point to a bottom-up process of diffusion of narratives, rather than top-down diffusion.

35538.title: Cognitive Limitations and Long-Term Care Use in the Netherlands: Evidence from the Lifelines Cohort Study
35538.zh_title: 认知局限与荷兰的长期护理使用：来自Lifelines队列研究的证据
35538.authors: Gaia Bagnasco, Pieter Bakx, Stijn Coremans, Bram Wouterse
35538.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们分析了荷兰65岁以上人口中认知障碍与长期护理使用之间的关联。为此，我们使用了Lifelines队列研究的数据，这些数据与荷兰统计局提供的行政记录相关联。我们发现，在认知障碍人群中，长期护理使用集中在一个亚组中：42%的认知障碍者不使用任何长期护理。同时，使用长期护理的认知障碍者支出较高，尤其是在养老院居住时。进一步分析显示，许多认知障碍者报告存在功能限制，且认知障碍与长期护理使用的关联超出了这些限制本身。
35538.abstract: We analyze the association between cognitive impairments and long-term care use in the 65+ population in the Netherlands. For this, we use data from the Lifelines Cohort Study that are linked to administrative records available through Statistics Netherlands. We find that, among those with cognitive impairments, long-term care use is concentrated in a subgroup: 42% of those with cognitive impairments do not use any long-term care. At the same time, individuals with cognitive impairments who use long-term care have high expenditures, in particular when living in nursing homes. Further analyses reveal that many individuals with cognitive impairments report functional limitations and that cognitive impairment is associated with long-term care use above and beyond these impairments. These findings highlight the importance of taking cognitive impairments into account when seeking to explain the determinants of long-term care use in research and when tailoring long-term care programs to the needs of the elderly when considering policy reforms.

35590.title: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt
35590.zh_abstract_excerpt: 受巴黎俱乐部框架之外新官方债权人出现的启发，我们研究了高级官方贷款与市场债务之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个定量主权违约模型，其中包含一个大型高级贷款人，借款条款与其进行谈判。从市场获得更多净融资会增强政府的谈判地位并改善双边条款。这种内生交叉弹性削弱了利差的约束力并加剧了债务稀释，即使双边借款有助于事后避免一些违约，也会导致福利损失。在预先设定的规则下，奖励市场发行可能足以产生此类损失，而最优规则反而会随着市场净融资的增加而提高双边利率。
35590.abstract: Motivated by the emergence of new official creditors outside the Paris Club framework, we study the interaction between senior official lending and market debt. We develop a quantitative sovereign default model featuring a large senior lender with whom borrowing terms are negotiated. Obtaining more net financing from the market strengthens the government’s bargaining position and improves bilateral terms. This endogenous cross-elasticity erodes the discipline of spreads and amplifies debt dilution, leading to welfare losses even as bilateral borrowing helps avert some defaults ex-post. With pre-specified rules, rewarding market issuance can be enough to generate such losses, and an optimal rule instead raises bilateral rates with net market financing. The direction of the cross-elasticity can thus guide in practice the assessment of new forms of bilateral sovereign debt.

35589.title: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
35589.zh_title: 收入冲击与家庭内部动态：来自保障收入实验的证据
35589.authors: Elizabeth Rhodes, David E. Broockman, Eva Vivalt, Patrick K. Krause, Sarah Miller, Alexander W. Bartik
35589.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当一个人的收入发生变化时，可能会影响其整个家庭。我们研究了一项无条件现金转移支付的家庭内部效应，其中1,000名个体被随机选中，在三年内每月获得1,000美元的转移支付，而由2,000名参与者组成的对照组在同一时期内每月获得50美元。我们发现对家庭稳定性的总体指标没有影响，尽管有提示性证据表明，处于恋爱关系中的受助者关系质量有所提高，对伴侣的信任度也有所增强。对朋友和家人的转移支付增加，这与受助者与他人分享部分额外收入的情况一致。
35589.abstract: When an individual's income changes, it can affect their entire household. We study the intrahousehold effects of an unconditional cash transfer in which 1,000 individuals were randomly selected to receive a $1,000 per month transfer for three years, while a control group of 2,000 participants received $50 per month over the same time period. We find no effects on aggregate measures of household stability, although there is suggestive evidence of improved relationship quality and greater trust in partners among recipients in relationships. Transfers to friends and family increase, consistent with recipients sharing some of the additional income with others. There are also spillovers on the income and employment-related outcomes of other household members: household income excluding the recipient decreases by about $1,700 per year, and partners are less likely to be promoted or to move to a better job. Other household members are significantly more likely to participate in education or training, and recipients are also more likely to report someone in their household having to forgo healthcare, potentially reflecting greater engagement with the healthcare system and the identification of previously unmet needs. We observe limited changes in decision-making power or division of labor within the household. Some indicators of intimate partner violence decline, particularly for women, but reported incidence is low and most estimates do not remain statistically significant after adjustment for multiple hypothesis testing. Subgroup differences are generally imprecise, although point estimates suggest larger education and health spillover effects when the recipient is a woman. Household structure also appears to mediates the impacts of the transfers.
35589.zh_abstract: 当一个人的收入发生变化时，可能会影响其整个家庭。我们研究了一项无条件现金转移支付的家庭内部效应，其中1,000名个体被随机选中，在三年内每月获得1,000美元的转移支付，而由2,000名参与者组成的对照组在同一时期内每月获得50美元。我们发现对家庭稳定性的总体指标没有影响，尽管有提示性证据表明，处于恋爱关系中的受助者关系质量有所提高，对伴侣的信任度也有所增强。对朋友和家人的转移支付增加，这与受助者与他人分享部分额外收入的情况一致。其他家庭成员的收入和就业相关结果也存在溢出效应：不包括受助者的家庭收入每年减少约1,700美元，伴侣获得晋升或跳槽到更好工作的可能性降低。其他家庭成员参加教育或培训的可能性显著增加，受助者也更有可能报告其家庭成员不得不放弃医疗保健，这可能反映了他们更多地参与医疗保健系统以及发现了以前未满足的需求。我们观察到家庭内部决策权或劳动分工的变化有限。一些亲密伴侣暴力的指标有所下降，尤其是女性，但报告的发病率较低，且大多数估计值在经过多重假设检验调整后不再具有统计显著性。亚组差异通常不精确，尽管点估计表明当受助者为女性时，教育和健康溢出效应更大。家庭结构似乎也调节了转移支付的影响。

35588.title: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
35588.zh_title: 计量经济学编码中的AI代理与提示工程
35588.authors: Sebastian Galiani, Federico Ariel López, Raul A. Sosa
35588.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究大型语言模型如何为计量经济学分析编写代码。我们比较了AI辅助编码的三个维度：统计软件（Stata、R或Python）、提示方式（零样本与少样本）以及代理程度，从编写单个脚本的聊天机器人到执行并修改自身代码的代理。在一个应用计量经济学和统计任务基准上，从聊天机器人转向受限代理将任务成功率从74%提高到96%，每次运行成本增加约8美分。对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和通过Codex的GPT-5.
35588.abstract: We study how large language models write code for econometric analysis. We compare three dimensions of AI-assisted coding: statistical software (Stata, R, or Python), prompting (zero-shot versus few-shot), and the degree of agency, from a chatbot that writes a single script to an agent that executes and revises its own code. On a benchmark of applied econometric and statistical tasks, moving from the chatbot to the constrained agent raises task success from 74 to 96 percent, at about eight additional cents per run. For Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 through Codex, few-shot prompting improves the chatbot far more than the constrained agent, indicating that prompting and agency act as substitutes. For these models, differences across statistical software are sizeable under the chatbot but largely disappear under the constrained agent.
35588.zh_abstract: 我们研究大型语言模型如何为计量经济学分析编写代码。我们比较了AI辅助编码的三个维度：统计软件（Stata、R或Python）、提示方式（零样本与少样本）以及代理程度，从编写单个脚本的聊天机器人到执行并修改自身代码的代理。在一个应用计量经济学和统计任务基准上，从聊天机器人转向受限代理将任务成功率从74%提高到96%，每次运行成本增加约8美分。对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和通过Codex的GPT-5.4，少样本提示对聊天机器人的改进远大于对受限代理的改进，表明提示和代理是替代关系。对于这些模型，在聊天机器人模式下，不同统计软件之间的差异很大，但在受限代理模式下差异基本消失。

35587.title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
35587.zh_title: 财产税与金融约束下的住房配置
35587.authors: Joshua Coven, Sebastian Golder, Arpit Gupta, Abdoulaye Ndiaye
35587.zh_abstract_excerpt: 低财产税加剧了老年房主的锁定效应，限制了年轻家庭获得住房的机会。提高财产税通过两个渠道将住房重新分配给年轻人：资本化到较低价格中减少了受金融约束购房者的所需首付，这是一种内嵌杠杆形式，而较高的税收负担则增加了老年房主的持有成本。在我们的代际交叠模型中，将加利福尼亚州的财产税提高到德克萨斯州的水平，会增加年轻家庭的住房拥有率，同时降低老年家庭的住房拥有率。取消递增基税也会降低老年家庭的住房拥有率，这表明他们的居住权是由遗产税优惠维持的。
35587.abstract: Low property taxes amplify lock-in among elderly homeowners, limiting housing access for young families. Raising them reallocates housing toward the young through two channels: capitalization into lower prices reduces required downpayments for financially constrained buyers, a form of embedded leverage, while higher tax obligations raise holding costs for older owners. In our overlapping generations model, raising California’s property taxes to Texas levels increases young homeownership while decreasing elderly homeownership. Removing step-up basis also lowers elderly homeownership, suggesting their tenure is sustained by bequest tax advantages. The tax treatment of housing shapes housing allocation across generations.
35587.zh_abstract: 低财产税加剧了老年房主的锁定效应，限制了年轻家庭获得住房的机会。提高财产税通过两个渠道将住房重新分配给年轻人：资本化到较低价格中减少了受金融约束购房者的所需首付，这是一种内嵌杠杆形式，而较高的税收负担则增加了老年房主的持有成本。在我们的代际交叠模型中，将加利福尼亚州的财产税提高到德克萨斯州的水平，会增加年轻家庭的住房拥有率，同时降低老年家庭的住房拥有率。取消递增基税也会降低老年家庭的住房拥有率，这表明他们的居住权是由遗产税优惠维持的。住房的税收待遇塑造了代际间的住房配置。

35586.title: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
35586.zh_title: 双重用途人工智能的分阶段准入与责任
35586.zh_abstract_excerpt: 监管者应如何将双重用途AI模型的分阶段准入与开发者责任结合起来？我构建了一个防御者和一个攻击者搜索相同软件缺陷的模型。发布后，责任会诱导更多的防御性搜索，但也使攻击者更加努力地搜索，从而限制了其对危害的影响。独家准入消除了这种战略反应，因此分阶段准入和责任在保护方面是互补的。防御性努力在发布日期临近时增加，使得额外的延迟逐渐变得不那么有效。因此，最优评估窗口是有界的，并且其对更大危害的反应会饱和。
35586.abstract: How should regulators combine staged access to a dual-use AI model with developer liability? I model a defender and an adversary searching for the same software flaws. After release, liability induces more defensive search but also makes the adversary search harder, limiting its effect on harm. Exclusive access removes this strategic response, so staged access and liability are complements in protection. Defensive effort rises towards the release date, making additional delay progressively less productive. Optimal evaluation windows are therefore bounded, and their response to greater harm saturates. Because defensive search uses real resources, the efficient liability rate can be below full internalisation of harm. That rate generally cannot induce the developer to choose the regulator's preferred release date, leaving a distinct role for a timing mandate.
35586.zh_abstract: 监管者应如何将双重用途AI模型的分阶段准入与开发者责任结合起来？我构建了一个防御者和一个攻击者搜索相同软件缺陷的模型。发布后，责任会诱导更多的防御性搜索，但也使攻击者更加努力地搜索，从而限制了其对危害的影响。独家准入消除了这种战略反应，因此分阶段准入和责任在保护方面是互补的。防御性努力在发布日期临近时增加，使得额外的延迟逐渐变得不那么有效。因此，最优评估窗口是有界的，并且其对更大危害的反应会饱和。由于防御性搜索使用实际资源，有效的责任率可以低于危害的完全内部化。该比率通常无法诱导开发者选择监管者偏好的发布日期，这为时间安排授权留下了独特的作用。

35585.title: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
35585.zh_title: 不孕的循环：代际传递与辅助生殖的作用
35585.authors: Viktoria Falk, Andreas Madestam, Emilia Simeonova
35585.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本研究考察了同一家庭内生育相关健康问题的代际持续性，以及辅助生殖技术（ART）的使用情况。利用瑞典全面的登记数据，我们记录了女儿和儿子生育困难的显著代际传递，且与父母的社会经济地位无关。父母报告有此类问题的女儿，其自身经历生育问题的可能性高出2.6个百分点，即19.4%。父母报告有生育困难的儿子，其经历生育问题的可能性增加1.7个百分点，即13.5%。这些关联在替代指标和样本中持续存在。
35585.abstract: This study examines the persistence of fertility-related health problems across generations within the same family, and the utilization of assisted reproductive technologies (ART). Using comprehensive Swedish registry data, we document significant intergenerational transmission of fertility difficulties for both daughters and sons, independent of parental socioeconomic status. Daughters whose parents reported such problems are 2.6 percentage points, or 19.4 percent, more likely to experience fertility problems themselves. Sons whose parents reported fertility difficulties experience a 1.7 percentage point, or 13.5 percent, increase. These associations persist across alternative measures and samples. Comparing biological and adopted children raised in the same households, we find that this phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by family awareness of fertility issues, pointing to biological and other factors that biological children share with their parents but adopted children do not. Medical technology works equally well for those who use it, and we find no significant association between the success of advanced fertility treatments and parental backgrounds. However, past generations’ fertility difficulties are associated both with higher medical expenses and with social costs such as increased likelihood of divorce.

35584.title: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
35584.zh_abstract_excerpt: 关于国内外包降低薪酬的证据主要来自现场转移，即工人转移到承包商处但保留相同工作。替代效应很少被观察到：工人是否失业、他们去向何处、收入如何演变。在巴西1993-1994年支持外包的改革中，这些改革对保安产生了差异化影响，此类转移很少见；企业转而采用职业性裁员，解雇保安而保留其他工人。被替代的保安的就业在五年内恢复，但许多人改变了职业，工资仍低约12%。终身损失平均为裁员前收入的1.2至1.
35584.abstract: Evidence that domestic outsourcing lowers pay comes largely from on-site transfers, in which workers move to a contractor but keep the same jobs. Displacement is rarely observed: whether workers lose their jobs, where they go, how earnings evolve. In Brazil’s 1993–1994 pro-outsourcing reforms, which differentially affected security guards, such transfers were rare; firms instead used occupational layoffs, shedding their guards while keeping other workers. Displaced guards’ employment recovered within five years, but many changed occupations and wages stayed about 12% lower. Lifetime losses average 1.2 to 1.5 years of pre-layoff earnings, concentrated among workers from high-wage firms, reflecting lost premia.

35583.title: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
35583.zh_title: 花钱以拯救：路易斯安那州根除丙型肝炎的订阅模式
35583.authors: Kevin Callison, Rena M. Conti, Jonathan Gruber, Jacob Wallace
35583.zh_abstract_excerpt: 支付方应如何在财政可持续性与获取变革性医疗技术之间取得平衡？我们研究了路易斯安那州2019年针对丙型肝炎（HCV）的医疗补助订阅模式，这是美国各州采用两部定价法以确保无限获取治愈性药物的首个案例。使用双重差分设计，比较HCV受益人与糖尿病或HIV受益人的支出，我们发现治疗量增加了两倍，医疗支出下降，新发HCV诊断下降了23%。该州在抗病毒药物上增加的3700万美元支出，在五年内产生了2.66亿美元的节省。
35583.abstract: How should payers balance fiscal sustainability with access to transformative medical technology? We study Louisiana’s 2019 Medicaid subscription model for hepatitis C (HCV), the first example of a U.S. state employing a two-part tariff to secure unlimited access to curative medicines. Using a differences-in-differences design comparing spending on beneficiaries with HCV to those with diabetes or HIV, we find that treatment volume tripled, medical spending fell, and new HCV diagnoses declined 23 percent. The state’s $37 million in incremental spending on antivirals generated $266 million in five-year savings. Innovative financing models can generate health benefits and near-term savings for payers.

35582.title: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
35582.authors: Randall Akee, Jimmy Chin, Daniel L. Crown
35582.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在本文中，我们描述了1981年至2021年移民工人收入同化的趋势。我们使用行政纵向数据，包含工人自在美国居住第一年及之后每年的收入，使我们能够识别最终离开美国的移民（此处称为回流移民）。我们利用这些数据首次考察了41年间收入同化的趋势，并分别估计了回流移民与留在美国的移民的收入同化情况。我们记录了1981年至2010年间抵达的移民的几个新事实。首先，大约五分之一至三分之一的移民在抵达后10年内从美国回流。
35582.abstract: In this paper, we characterize trends in the earnings assimilation of immigrant workers from 1981 to 2021. We use administrative longitudinal data that contain the earnings of workers beginning in their first year of residence in the United States and in each year thereafter, allowing us to identify immigrants who eventually leave the United States (referred to here as return migrants). We use those data to produce the first examination of trends in earnings assimilation over a 41-year period and to estimate earnings assimilation separately for return migrants versus those who stay in the United States. We document several new facts about immigrants who arrived between 1981 to 2010. First, roughly one-fifth to one-third of immigrants return migrate from the United States within 10 years after arrival. Second, return migrants have entry earnings similar to those of permanent migrants but experience slower rates of earnings growth. Third, earnings assimilation occurs relatively quickly for cohorts arriving since the mid-1990s: The earnings of permanent immigrants converge, or come close to converging, with those of native-born people within 10 years after arrival. Migrants from earlier arrival cohorts experience significant earnings growth but generally do not converge to that of the native born. We discuss how changes in the labor market quality of immigrant cohorts (measured by their relative earnings upon entry) and selective return migration play an important role in determining whether repeated cross-sectional data over- or underestimate earnings assimilation.
35582.zh_abstract: 在本文中，我们描述了1981年至2021年移民工人收入同化的趋势。我们使用行政纵向数据，包含工人自在美国居住第一年及之后每年的收入，使我们能够识别最终离开美国的移民（此处称为回流移民）。我们利用这些数据首次考察了41年间收入同化的趋势，并分别估计了回流移民与留在美国的移民的收入同化情况。我们记录了1981年至2010年间抵达的移民的几个新事实。首先，大约五分之一至三分之一的移民在抵达后10年内从美国回流。其次，回流移民的初始收入与永久移民相似，但收入增长速度较慢。第三，自1990年代中期以来抵达的群体的收入同化发生得相对较快：永久移民的收入在抵达后10年内与本土出生人口趋同或接近趋同。早期抵达群体的移民经历了显著的收入增长，但通常未与本土出生人口趋同。我们讨论了移民群体劳动力市场质量的变化（以其进入时的相对收入衡量）和选择性回流移民在决定重复横截面数据是高估还是低估收入同化方面的重要作用。

35581.title: How Steep is the Phillips Curve in Developing Economies? A Sufficient Statistics Approach and Estimates for India
35581.zh_title: 发展中经济体的菲利普斯曲线有多陡峭？充分统计量方法及对印度的估计
35581.authors: Juan Herreño, Noémie Pinardon-Touati, Malte Thie
35581.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们估计了印度的菲利普斯曲线，以揭示发展中经济体的产出-通胀权衡。我们开发了一种基于充分统计量的方法来估计菲利普斯曲线的斜率，该方法适用于广泛的新凯恩斯主义模型。利用可移植的因果研究设计，我们估计了企业层面成本冲击在不同时间范围内向价格的传导，以及不同聚合水平上边际成本曲线的斜率。这些经验矩映射到菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并分解为三个项：价格刚性、微观实际刚性和宏观实际刚性。印度的菲利普斯曲线斜率比美国陡峭一个数量级。
35581.abstract: We estimate the Phillips curve for India to shed light on the output-inflation tradeoff in developing economies. We develop a method to estimate the slope of the Phillips curve based on sufficient statistics that apply to a broad class of New Keynesian models. Using portable causal research designs, we estimate the firm-level passthrough of cost shocks into prices at different horizons, and the slope of marginal cost curves at different levels of aggregation. These empirical moments map into the slope of the Phillips curve and yield a decomposition into three terms: price rigidity, micro real rigidities, and macro real rigidities. The slope of the Phillips curve in India is one order of magnitude steeper than in the United States. This difference is explained by weaker macro real rigidities and less rigid prices. Extending the model to allow for input misallocation, we find that the re-allocative effects of monetary policy affect the Phillips curve, but this effect is small.

35580.title: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
35580.zh_title: 谨慎的职业：不完全市场下的工作流动性
35580.authors: Alex Clymo, Piotr Denderski, Yusuf Mercan, Benjamin Schoefer
35580.zh_abstract_excerpt: 工作流动是有风险的，工人是风险厌恶的，保险市场是不完全的。本文研究了这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作转换：他们过于重视工作安全性而非工资和生产率收益。我们通过在一项定制的代表性调查中引出在职工人的工资-安全无差异曲线来证明这种权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人需要1.63%的加薪才能接受新工作中每年额外一个百分点的失业风险。我们通过将我们的机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。
35580.abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
35580.zh_abstract: 工作流动是有风险的，工人是风险厌恶的，保险市场是不完全的。本文研究了这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作转换：他们过于重视工作安全性而非工资和生产率收益。我们通过在一项定制的代表性调查中引出在职工人的工资-安全无差异曲线来证明这种权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人需要1.63%的加薪才能接受新工作中每年额外一个百分点的失业风险。我们通过将我们的机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。工作既在工资（生产率）上不同，也在失业风险上不同，风险厌恶的工人通过非状态依赖债券进行自我保险以应对失业风险，同时在岗和离岗搜索。我们发现，完全市场反事实将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受有风险但高生产率的报价，从而提高生产率（提高1.3%）和就业创造——以及失业和失业率。

35579.title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks, Bonds (and Options), Redux
35579.zh_title: 股票、债券（和期权）回报中的共同风险因素，再探
35579.authors: Zhongtian Chen, Nikolai Roussanov, Xiaoliang Wang, Dongchen Zou
35579.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们识别出一个强大的共同风险因素结构，该结构在公司证券中普遍存在：股票、公司债券和期权。共同因素与可观察因素和关键经济指标密切相关。这些因素解释了个体资产回报的大部分变化，尽管定价误差仍然存在。跨资产类别的联合均值-方差有效投资组合实现了高夏普比率，部分源于对共同风险来源的跨市场对冲。我们基于市场间共同因素风险溢价的差异开发了一种市场分割度量，并记录了显著的分割程度。
35579.abstract: We identify a strong common risk factor structure that is pervasive across corporate securities: stocks, corporate bonds, and options. The common factors are closely linked to observable factors and key economic indicators. These factors explain much of the variation in individual asset returns, although pricing errors persist. A joint mean-variance efficient portfolio across asset classes achieves a high Sharpe ratio, resulting in part from cross-market hedging of the common sources of risk. We develop a measure of market segmentation based on differences in the common factor risk premia between markets and document a significant degree of segmentation.

35578.title: Reconstructing a Century of U.S. Corporate Bonds: Credit Risk in Historical Perspective
35578.zh_title: 重构美国公司债券百年史：历史视角下的信用风险
35578.authors: Mohammad Ghaderi, Sébastien Plante, Nikolai Roussanov, Sang Byung Seo
35578.zh_abstract_excerpt: 公司债券投资者是否因承担信用风险而获得补偿？我们构建了一个跨越128年的新历史公司债券数据库，以估算与股票风险溢价相对应的公司债券溢价。通过将手工收集的档案数据与现代数据源相结合，我们汇编了一个包含超过100,000只债券和700万条观测值的面板数据集。虽然近期样本表明公司债券超额收益在很大程度上反映了期限溢价，但我们的长期样本揭示了一个规模可观且统计显著的信用风险溢价。
35578.abstract: Do corporate bond investors earn compensation for bearing credit risk? We construct a new historical corporate bond database spanning 128 years to estimate a corporate bond counterpart to the equity risk premium. Combining hand-collected archival data with modern sources, we assemble a panel of over 100,000 bonds and 7 million observations. While recent samples suggest corporate bond excess returns largely reflect the term premium, our long sample reveals a sizable and statistically significant credit risk premium. Credit spreads predict future corporate bond returns and macroeconomic aggregates, though their ability to forecast business cycle fluctuations weakens when prewar data are included.

35577.title: The Value Gap: Europe Cannot Scale
35577.zh_title: 价值差距：欧洲无法扩张规模
35577.authors: Bo Becker, Efraim Benmelech, Joao Monteiro
35577.zh_abstract_excerpt: 2008年，美国上市公司总市值比欧洲上市公司高出约三分之一。到2023年，这一差距扩大至300%以上，差额达34万亿美元。估值差距是广泛存在的，而非集中于少数超级明星企业，且主要由企业价值差异驱动，而非上市公司数量差异。跨行业来看，在研发密集型行业和规模报酬较高的行业中，差距更大。欧洲企业的规模与母国GDP密切相关，而美国企业的规模与母州GDP无关。
35577.abstract: In 2008, the aggregate market value of U.S.-listed firms was roughly one-third higher than that of European-listed firms. By 2023, it was more than 300% higher, a difference of $34 trillion. The valuation gap is broad-based, rather than concentrated among a few superstar firms, and is driven by differences in firm values, not in the number of listed firms. Across sectors, the gap is larger in R&D-intensive industries and in industries with high returns to scale. European firms’ size is strongly correlated with home-country GDP, whereas U.S. firms’ size is unrelated to home-state GDP. Smaller European firms also face a particularly large cost-of-capital gap and do not appear able to substitute debt for limited access to equity financing, including venture capital. Taken together, these facts suggest that financial and product-market frictions constrain European firms’ ability to scale.

35576.title: Do Children's Genes Evoke Educational Expectations? Direct Genetic Effects on Parents' and Teachers' College Encouragement
35576.zh_title: 儿童基因会引发教育期望吗？基因对父母和教师大学鼓励的直接效应
35576.zh_abstract_excerpt: 父母和教师的期望与抱负是教育成果的关键驱动因素，然而，究竟是什么因果性地塑造了这些期望仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们通过利用减数分裂的随机实验来回答这一问题：即在父母基因型给定的条件下，子代基因型是随机的，从而能够将独特的儿童特征从更一般的家庭和住户环境中分离出来。利用威斯康星纵向研究，我们采用孟德尔插补法来估计18个多基因指数对大学鼓励的直接遗传效应，并剔除父母遗传背景的影响。
35576.abstract: Parents’ and teachers’ expectations and aspirations are critical drivers of educational outcomes, yet what causally shapes these expectations remains unclear. In the present study, we address this question by deploying the random experiment of meiosis: namely, conditional on parental genotype, offspring genotype is random, allowing for the unconfounding of unique child characteristics from the more general family and household environment. Using the Wisconsin Longitudinal Study, we employ Mendelian imputation to estimate the direct genetic effects of 18 polygenic indices on college encouragement, net of parental genetic background. The genetic propensity for educational attainment and mathematical ability predict stronger expectations of college attendance, while smoking behavior predicts weaker expectations. Psychiatric traits show no effects after multiple-testing correction, indicating that responses are concentrated on cognitive and behavioral traits. Mediation analysis finds that prospectively measured teachers’ encouragement accounts for roughly a quarter of the genetic effects on educational attainment for cognitive traits, but not for psychiatric traits. Genetic effects on expectations are amplified among high-SES parents and first-born children. Thus, genetic influences on educational expectations are narrow in trait scope and uneven across families, with encouragement serving as one channel linking genetic differences to educational inequality.
35576.zh_abstract: 父母和教师的期望与抱负是教育成果的关键驱动因素，然而，究竟是什么因果性地塑造了这些期望仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们通过利用减数分裂的随机实验来回答这一问题：即在父母基因型给定的条件下，子代基因型是随机的，从而能够将独特的儿童特征从更一般的家庭和住户环境中分离出来。利用威斯康星纵向研究，我们采用孟德尔插补法来估计18个多基因指数对大学鼓励的直接遗传效应，并剔除父母遗传背景的影响。教育成就和数学能力的遗传倾向预测了更强的大学入学期望，而吸烟行为则预测了较弱的期望。经过多重检验校正后，精神特质未显示出效应，表明反应集中在认知和行为特质上。中介分析发现，前瞻性测量的教师鼓励约占认知特质对教育成就遗传效应的四分之一，但对精神特质则无此作用。遗传对期望的影响在高社会经济地位父母和头胎子女中被放大。因此，遗传对教育期望的影响在特质范围上是狭窄的，且在家庭间是不均匀的，鼓励作为连接遗传差异与教育不平等的一个渠道。

35575.title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
35575.zh_title: 消费中的可观察性与社会互动
35575.zh_abstract_excerpt: 通过在意大利消费者预期调查中进行随机调查实验，我们研究了可观察性和共同性如何影响对1000欧元雇主奖金的反应。使个人特定奖金对同事可见，会使边际消费倾向降低3个百分点。在可观察的条件下，将奖金扩展到所有同事则会使边际消费倾向提高6个百分点。在社会互动模型下，后一种效应意味着社会互动参数为0.16，乘数为1.2。因此，消费反应不仅取决于资源，还取决于收入冲击是私人的、公共的，还是在显著的同伴群体内共享的。
35575.abstract: Using a randomized survey experiment in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we study how observability and commonality shape responses to a €1,000 employer bonus. Making an idiosyncratic bonus observable to coworkers lowers the marginal propensity to consume by 3 percentage points. Conditional on observability, extending the bonus to all coworkers raises it by 6 percentage points. Under a social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of 0.16 and a multiplier of 1.2. Thus, consumption responses depend not only on resources but also on whether income shocks are private, public, or shared within a salient peer group.

35574.abstract: We ask a representative sample to write prompts seeking spending and investing advice from LLMs, then simulate the lifetime effects of following the advice under realistic asset and labor market conditions. Applying this method to GPT-5.2, we find following the advice would move respondents toward life cycle theory: broader participation in diversified equity funds, age-declining equity shares, and larger savings buffers. Recommendations vary systematically by gender, prior AI experience, and financial literacy. For gender, two-thirds of recommended equity-share differences arise from men and women writing different prompts (demand), while one-third arise from gender labels attached to otherwise identical prompts (supply).

35573.abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.

35572.abstract: We show that quantitative asset pricing models, built to address the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles, systematically fail when applied to open economies: they cannot generate the large and persistent interest rate differentials we observe between risky and safe currencies. This failure stems from the key mechanism that produces their success in matching both closed-economy puzzles: In these models, the mean of the stochastic discount factor offsets its variance nearly one-for-one, which immobilizes interest rates --- so that differences in expected currency returns across countries must arise almost exclusively from predictable changes in exchange rates, at odds with the data. We prove this result in a broad class of models that allows for market incompleteness and exchange rate disconnect, requiring only that each country's risk-free asset is priced by investors who demand compensation for risk in line with observed risk premia. We argue this tension between canonical asset pricing and international macroeconomic models is a key reason researchers have struggled to reconcile the observed behavior of exchange rates, interest rates, and capital flows across countries.

35571.title: Winning is Contagious: Social Learning and the Dynamics of Union Support
35571.zh_title: 胜利具有传染性：社会学习与工会支持动态
35571.authors: Ellora Derenoncourt, Arindrajit Dube, Suresh Naidu, Heather Sarsons, Niharika Singh
35571.zh_abstract_excerpt: 工会增长在历史上是间歇性爆发的。我们将1961年至2025年的工会选举数据与一项涉及9,000名低工资工人的大规模信息实验相结合，研究社会学习在工会增长中的作用。从观察上看，势均力敌的选举胜利会导致州内行业未来的胜利。在实验中，关于近期工会胜利的信息增加了工会支持和关于同事支持的信念，其影响集中在信息环境薄弱和同事基线支持度低的工人中。相比之下，关于劳动力市场紧张程度的信息影响甚微。我们的结果强调了社会学习作为工会增长的一种机制。
35571.abstract: Union growth has historically happened in spurts. We combine union election data from 1961–2025 with a large-scale information experiment involving 9,000 low-wage workers to study the role of social learning in union growth. Observationally, close election wins cause future wins within state-industries. Experimentally, information about recent union wins increases union support and beliefs about co-worker support, with effects concentrated among workers with weak information environments and low baseline coworker support. In contrast, information about labor market tightness has little effect. Our results highlight social learning as a mechanism for union growth.

35570.title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
35570.zh_title: 溢出效应实验中的稳健信号最大化
35570.authors: Kirill Borusyak, Peter Hull, Evan M. Munro
35570.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了估计溢出效应实验的最优设计与分析。假设一个已知的（例如，线性的）暴露映射，我们刻画了在针对一大类不可观测变量分布时，最小化最坏情况渐近方差（worst-case asymptotic variance）的处理分配分布和基于回归的估计量。设计问题产生了一个直观的解决方案，其中规划者在溢出信号强度与溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题产生了一个简单的重新中心化工具变量估计量，以最好地利用这种变异。
35570.abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases -- such as clustered exposure-- and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.

35569.title: Fortunate Sons: Elite Political Selection in American History
35569.zh_title: 幸运之子：美国历史上的精英政治选拔
35569.authors: James J. Feigenbaum, Andrew B. Hall, Daniel M. Thompson, Jesse Yoder
35569.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们追溯了1830年至1950年间出生的国会议员（MC）的家庭出身，将每位议员、其父母及其兄弟与全量人口普查数据相链接。未来的国会议员一直是经济上的离群值。到1940年，近60%的18至40岁议员拥有大学学位，而国会外可比年轻男性中这一比例不足5%。在19世纪的人口普查中，作为成年人的议员所拥有的财富大约是人口统计学匹配对照组的三倍。他们也来自经济精英家庭：他们的父亲收入更高、受教育程度更高、拥有更多财富。
35569.abstract: We trace the family origins of Members of Congress (MC) born between 1830 and 1950, linking each MC, their parents, and their brothers to the complete-count censuses. Future MCs have always been economic outliers. By 1940, close to 60 percent of MCs aged 18--40 held a college degree, against under 5 percent of comparable young men outside Congress. In the 19th-century censuses, MCs as adults held roughly three times the wealth of demographically matched controls. They also come from economically elite families: their fathers earn more, attain more education, and hold more wealth. The brothers of future MCs sit between the population and the MCs themselves. Across the socioeconomic measures we compare, we calculate that roughly half of an MC's adult premium is shared with his brother and the other half is his own. Even as the American economy and political system have changed, the family background gap has widened over the last century and a half. Wealth, household servants, and four separate occupation-based scores all show the gap holding or growing across cohorts. We study four Progressive-Era reforms in a triple-difference design---women's suffrage, the secret ballot, direct primaries, and the direct election of senators---and none produce detectable shifts in who reaches Congress. Our results document a Congress drawn from the most fortunate families in American society in every cohort we observe.
35569.zh_abstract: 我们追溯了1830年至1950年间出生的国会议员（MC）的家庭出身，将每位议员、其父母及其兄弟与全量人口普查数据相链接。未来的国会议员一直是经济上的离群值。到1940年，近60%的18至40岁议员拥有大学学位，而国会外可比年轻男性中这一比例不足5%。在19世纪的人口普查中，作为成年人的议员所拥有的财富大约是人口统计学匹配对照组的三倍。他们也来自经济精英家庭：他们的父亲收入更高、受教育程度更高、拥有更多财富。未来议员的兄弟则介于普通人口和议员本人之间。在我们比较的社会经济指标中，我们计算出议员成年期溢价的大约一半与其兄弟共享，另一半是他自己的。即使美国经济和政治体制发生了变化，家庭背景差距在过去一个半世纪中仍在扩大。财富、家庭佣工和四个独立的基于职业的评分都显示，这一差距在各代际队列中保持或增长。我们使用三重差分设计研究了四项进步时代改革——妇女选举权、无记名投票、直接初选和参议员直接选举——但没有一项对谁进入国会产生可检测的影响。我们的结果记录了一个在我们观察的每一个队列中，都从美国社会最幸运的家庭中产生的国会。

35599.title: From Social Savings to Spatial Equilibrium: Evaluating Transportation Improvements in Quantitative Spatial Models
35599.zh_title: 从社会储蓄到空间均衡：量化空间模型中的交通改善评估
35599.authors: Treb Allen, Simon Fuchs, Woan Foong Wong
35599.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们如何评估交通基础设施投资的福利收益？我们提出了一个量化空间框架，该框架整合了交通和基础设施改善的经济响应，并推导出总福利对交通网络变化的弹性。由此得到的公式扩展了传统的“社会储蓄”方法，以纳入路线和模式选择、集聚和分散外部性以及交通拥堵。我们将该公式应用于美国货运网络，并评估了减少美国州际公路系统各路段成本的收益。传统和扩展的衡量指标在总体上密切相关，但在估计收益水平和一些高价值路段的排名上存在差异。
35599.abstract: How do we evaluate the welfare gains from transport infrastructure investment? We present a quantitative spatial framework that integrates traffic and economic responses to infrastructure improvements and derives the elasticity of aggregate welfare to changes in the transportation network. The resulting formula extends the traditional ``social savings'' method to incorporate route and mode choice, agglomeration and dispersion externalities, and traffic congestion. We apply the formula to the U.S. freight network and assess the benefits of reducing costs on each segment of the U.S. Interstate Highway System. The traditional and extended measures are closely related overall, but they differ in the level of estimated gains and in the ranking of some highly valued links. Where the rankings differ, network position determines how congestion and spatial adjustment alter a link's measured benefit.

35598.title: Choosing To Fail: Managerial Liability, Risk Management and Voluntary Exits of Banks
35598.zh_title: 选择失败：管理层责任、风险管理与银行的自愿退出
35598.authors: Haelim Anderson, Charles W. Calomiris, Jennifer S. Rhee
35598.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了1893年恐慌期间及之后，扩展的股东责任如何塑造银行处置，比较了加利福尼亚州银行（无限责任）与国家银行（双重责任）。利用新汇编的数据，将加利福尼亚州银行行长与人口普查记录以及来自检查报告的国家银行股票持有数据联系起来，我们衡量了管理者对扩展责任的个人敞口。对于加利福尼亚州银行，传统的基本面因素可以预测非自愿清算，但不能解释自愿退出。
35598.abstract: We study how extended stockholder liability shaped bank resolution during and after the Panic of 1893, comparing California state banks (unlimited liability) with national banks (double liability). Using newly assembled data linking California state bank presidents to census records and national bank stock ownership data from Examination Reports, we measure managers’ personal exposures to extended liability. For California state banks, traditional fundamentals predict involuntary liquidations but do not explain voluntary exits. Instead, voluntary exits are driven by managers’ liability exposure, local economic risk, and personal wealth, consistent with managers responding to unlimited liability by initiating preemptive, orderly resolutions. For national banks under double liability, voluntary and involuntary liquidations are more similar, and personal exposure plays a smaller role in risk management. These findings show that substantial personal liability exposure can operate for modern prudential tools like compensation clawbacks and living wills. However, such extended liability also magnifies credit contractions during downturns, highlighting a fundamental tradeoff between micro-stability and macroeconomic fragility in regulatory design.
35598.zh_abstract: 我们研究了1893年恐慌期间及之后，扩展的股东责任如何塑造银行处置，比较了加利福尼亚州银行（无限责任）与国家银行（双重责任）。利用新汇编的数据，将加利福尼亚州银行行长与人口普查记录以及来自检查报告的国家银行股票持有数据联系起来，我们衡量了管理者对扩展责任的个人敞口。对于加利福尼亚州银行，传统的基本面因素可以预测非自愿清算，但不能解释自愿退出。相反，自愿退出是由管理者的责任敞口、地方经济风险和个人财富驱动的，这与管理者响应无限责任而主动发起预防性、有序处置的行为一致。对于双重责任下的国家银行，自愿和非自愿清算更为相似，个人敞口在风险管理中的作用较小。这些发现表明，大量的个人责任敞口可以发挥类似于现代审慎工具（如薪酬追回和生前遗嘱）的作用。然而，这种扩展责任也会放大衰退期间的信贷收缩，凸显了监管设计中微观稳定与宏观脆弱性之间的根本权衡。

35597.title: AI in a Fragmenting World
35597.authors: Barry Eichengreen, George Cui, Asmaa A. El-Ganainy, Yevgeniya Koriyenko, Elyad Shojaei, Li Zeng, Shihangyin Zhang
35597.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们将两个全球趋势——人工智能（AI）和地缘经济碎片化——联系起来，探讨碎片化如何影响AI的国际扩散、收益的规模及其在各经济体之间的分配。我们一般性地提出这些问题，但也特别关注中东、北非、阿富汗和巴基斯坦（MENAP）经济体。虽然AI的影响可能深远，但收益既非有保障也非均衡。前沿AI创新集中在少数经济体，而其他国家则通过参与供应链或采用AI获益——其结果受其在全球贸易和生产网络中的地位及其AI准备程度的影响。
35597.abstract: We link two global trends—AI and geoeconomic fragmentation—asking how fragmentation affects the international diffusion of AI, the magnitude of gains, and their distribution across economies. We ask these questions in general but also with a focus on the MENAP economies. While the effects of AI are potentially far-reaching, the benefits are neither guaranteed nor even. Frontier AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while countries benefiting through supply-chain participation or AI adoption—with outcomes shaped by their position in global trade and production networks and their AI preparedness. Geoeconomic fragmentation slows AI diffusion and reshapes its distribution by raising trade costs, restricting technology and data flows, fragmenting digital services, and reducing cross-border investment and collaboration. Yet proactive policy choices can turn this dynamic: economies that position themselves as connectors—maintaining trade and technology links across multiple partners—can potentially capture diverted flows and outperform even the no-fragmentation benchmark. For the MENAP economies, diversified links with all major technology hubs can cushion the effects of fragmentation and provide a structural foundation to emerge as net beneficiaries of AI diffusion, but realizing that potential requires reducing AI-related trade costs, improving AI preparedness, and building local AI-related capacity.

35596.title: The Effects of Ads on Beliefs and Implications for Consumer Search
35596.zh_title: 广告对信念的影响及其对消费者搜索的启示
35596.authors: Jean-Pierre H. Dubé, Ilya Morozov, Franklin She, Anna Tuchman
35596.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了店内展示广告如何通过广告内容直接传达产品价格和质量信息，以及消费者如何从广告的存在和内容中推断信息。我们在一个模拟的在线商店中进行了一项激励性实验，随机分配广告曝光、广告内容和广告产品的价格，同时收集参与者的信念和选择。即使广告文案没有直接揭示价格或质量属性，展示广告也会改变消费者对价格和质量的信念。我们提供的证据表明，这些信念变化对广告产品的搜索和购买产生了因果效应。
35596.abstract: We study how in-store display ads communicate information about a product’s price and quality, both directly through ad content and indirectly through inferences consumers draw from the presence and content of the ad. We run an incentivized experiment in a simulated online store, randomizing ad exposure, ad content, and the advertised product’s price, while also eliciting participants’ beliefs and choices. Display ads shift beliefs about price and quality, even when the ad copy does not directly reveal either attribute. We provide evidence that these belief shifts have a causal effect on searches and purchases of the advertised product. Using a stylized search model, we show that while visibility explains most of the ad effects, belief updating explains a statistically and economically significant share. Casting ad content choice as an information design problem, we show that advertisers may find it optimal to conceal product information even when it exceeds consumers’ expectations.

35595.title: Dynamic Effects of Trade
35595.authors: Benny Kleinman, Ernest Liu, Stephen J. Redding
35595.zh_abstract_excerpt: 贸易带来总体福利收益的存在是国际经济学中的经典见解之一。然而，这些传统的福利收益是静态的，因为它们将某一时点的现有要素供给和生产技术视为给定。最近的研究强调了贸易通过内生要素积累和技术创新随时间推移产生的动态效应，尽管对这些动态效应的量化程度尚未达成共识，不如对其静态对应效应那样一致。这项研究的关键见解是：贸易自由化的短期和长期反应不同；资本积累放大了国际贸易冲击的影响；贸易可以通过改变供应商构成来促进技术采用和思想传播；
35595.abstract: The existence of aggregate welfare gains from trade is one of the classic insights from international economics. However, these conventional welfare gains are static, in the sense that they take existing factor supplies and production technologies at a point in time as given. Recent research has highlighted dynamic effects of trade through endogenous factor accumulation and technological innovation over time, although there remains less consensus about the quantitative magnitude of these dynamic effects than about their static counterparts. Key insights from this research are that short-run and long-run responses to trade liberalization differ; capital accumulation amplifies the impact of international trade shocks; trade can facilitate technology adoption and the diffusion of ideas by changing the composition of suppliers; effects on lifetime welfare differ substantially from those on steady-state welfare, once transition dynamics are taken into account; and market failures can either magnify the overall welfare gains from trade or rationalize activist trade and industrial policies.
